goal: Add the smallest backend saved-status summary path so race detail can ask whether the viewed race is already saved without hydrating the full decorated /api/races list.

completedRounds.summary: Added a lightweight auth-protected saved-status endpoint, a direct repository lookup, and focused controller coverage.

runtimeProof.details: This lane only performed targeted tests and compile verification. No local backend restart or live /api runtime proof was run here.

risks: Saved-status resolves by runner plus case-insensitive race name and returns the earliest event-date match to mirror the current /api/races ordering, so duplicate same-name saved races will map to the first sorted entry.
mustPreserve: Keep GET /api/races/saved-status auth-protected like the other /api/races endpoints.
Keep the saved-status lookup lightweight and avoid decorating run activity data.
mergeNotes: Frontend can call GET /api/races/saved-status?name=<race name> and read { saved, raceId }.
The repository method intentionally mirrors the existing /api/races list ordering with OrderByEventDateAsc.
